en.title: Baked Rice with Rumi Cheese

steps.n1: Pick over and wash the rice.
steps.n2: Cook it in the milk over low heat until tender.
steps.n3: Add 3 level tablespoons of the rumi cheese and season the mixture with salt and pepper.
steps.n4: Pour into a greased ovenproof dish and sprinkle the top with the rest of the cheese.
steps.n5: Bake in a hot oven until the top browns.

legacySteps: Pick over and wash the rice.
Cook it in the milk over low heat until tender.
Add 3 level tablespoons of the rumi cheese and season the mixture with salt and pepper.
Pour into a greased ovenproof dish and sprinkle the top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake in a hot oven until the top browns.
